title: IMDB movie reviews
description: Movie reviews labelled positive or negative. A classic first sentiment model.

title: Rotten Tomatoes reviews
description: Short movie review sentences, positive or negative. Small and quick to train on.

title: SST-2 sentiment
description: Movie review phrases labelled positive or negative.

title: Yelp reviews (positive or negative)
description: Restaurant and business reviews, positive or negative.

title: AG News topics
description: News headlines and descriptions sorted into four topics: world, sports, business, science.

title: DBpedia topics
description: Wikipedia article summaries sorted into 14 kinds, such as company, artist or animal.

title: Emotions in tweets
description: English tweets labelled with one of six emotions: sadness, joy, love, anger, fear, surprise.

title: GoEmotions
description: Reddit comments labelled with 27 emotions or neutral.

title: SMS spam
description: Text messages labelled spam or not spam. Tiny, and a great first project.

title: TweetEval
description: Tweets for several tasks: sentiment, emoji, hate speech, irony and more.

title: SNLI sentence pairs
description: Pairs of sentences: does the second follow from the first, contradict it, or neither?

title: SQuAD questions
description: Questions about Wikipedia paragraphs, with the answer in the text.

title: Dolly 15k instructions
description: Instructions and answers written by people, for teaching a model to follow instructions.

title: Alpaca (cleaned)
description: Instruction and answer pairs, cleaned of common mistakes. Good for a first instruction-tuned model.

title: Alpaca
description: The original Alpaca instruction set. Not for commercial use.

title: No Robots
description: Instructions and answers written by skilled people. Not for commercial use.

title: GSM8K maths word problems
description: School maths word problems with step-by-step answers.

title: WikiText
description: Good Wikipedia articles as plain text, for training a model to write.

title: Iris flowers
description: Measurements of 150 iris flowers in three species. The smallest classic dataset there is.

title: Adult census income
description: People's age, work and education: does their income pass 50,000 dollars a year?

title: Breast cancer (Wisconsin)
description: Cell measurements labelled harmless or harmful.

title: MNIST handwritten digits
description: Small pictures of handwritten digits 0 to 9.

title: Fashion-MNIST
description: Small pictures of clothes in ten kinds: shirts, shoes, bags and more.

title: CIFAR-10
description: Small colour photos in ten kinds: planes, cars, birds, cats and more.

title: Food-101
description: Photos of 101 kinds of food.

title: Speech Commands
description: One-second recordings of spoken words like yes, no, up and down.

title: LibriSpeech
description: Audiobook recordings with their text, for speech recognition.
